# `rumor` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "rumor" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/rumor/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | `rumor-<nn>-<slug>`; `<nn>` is the bible 6.2 number. |
| `notes` | string | required | Author-facing: what it points at and why it is told. |
| `region` | `"valley"` \| `"harbour"` | required | Where it circulates: the valley (1-12, 19-20) or the river and harbour (13-18). |
| `source` | list of string (at least 1) | required | The NPCs who tell it first-hand (glossary NPC ids). |
| `sourceTags` | list of string | — | Crowd sources, e.g. "tidemarket" for gossip with no single teller. |
| `truth` | `"true"` \| `"half"` \| `"false"` | required | Whether the rumour is true, half-true or false. |
| `target` | string | required | What it points at: a glossary place, NPC or term id, or a quest id. |
| `text` | string | required | The rumour as it is told, in the bible. |
| `secondHand` | object | — | How a valley teller repeats it; hearing it this way never marks the target visited. |
| `secondHand.teller` | string | required | Who repeats it second-hand (Dot, in the valley). |
| `secondHand.text` | string | required |  |
| `debunk` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Required when false: the ways the player can learn it is false. |
| `debunk[].via` | `"dive"` | required |  |
| `debunk[].place` | string | required | Where the player goes to see for themselves. |
| `debunk[].via` | `"ask"` | required |  |
| `debunk[].npc` | string | required | Who laughs it off or sets the player straight. |
